scope: Comparison of finite acquired correspondences, not global intelligence or biological equivalence.
participant_input: raw token sequence with relative times when applicable
current paired observed consequence only during experience
principal: DIRECT: acquire8, query8, add8, query16, reviseone, query16. Context conditional task and ordered-event task are separately reported cohorts.
comparability: Same observable stream and external task. Actual admission, changed native history, response coverage, processing and physical resources are reported separately. Equal data does not imply equal computation, memory, or microscopic mechanism.
B1: Mutable observed-key memory: stores only the last paired observed consequence per prepared observable key. Unknown keys return no response. Ordered task discards positive gap magnitude while preserving slots by declared interface; this is an engineered representational invariance.
B2: Small two-layer tanh classifier, supervised only by paired demonstrations, with bounded uniform FIFO replay. Not a reproduction of continual backpropagation, ImageNet, or large-scale benchmarks.

sources.title: Loss of plasticity in deep continual learning
sources.use: Distinguish maintaining ability to acquire from preserving previous knowledge. The small present tasks do not test long-horizon loss of plasticity.

sources.title: Computationally Budgeted Continual Learning: What Does Matter?
sources.use: Report actual replay and computation budgets and include a simple uniform-memory baseline. No transfer of the paper's empirical ranking to DEE.
